column1: # Per-repo stack skills for scripts/stack.sh. One row per technology, tab-separated:
# detect: extended regex, case-insensitive, matched against the repo's dependency files (names as "file: <name>", then contents).
# kind: skills = cherry-picked with the skills CLI into .claude/skills/, source owner/repo@<commit>;
#       plugin = marketplace plugin enabled at local scope, source owner/repo#<commit>;
#       synced = claude.ai-synced plugin (off user-wide by setup.sh) turned on in .claude/settings.local.json;
#       library-skills = skills that ship inside installed packages (tiangolo/library-skills).
# default: y = official or vendor source, offered as [Y/n]; n = community source, offered as [y/N]; read the skill text first.
# Commits recorded 2026-11-26 (git ls-remote HEAD). Bump deliberately, after reading the upstream diff.

column7: Official (Pydantic). Logfire plugin skipped: hosted MCP and telemetry capture.
Official. The eight migrate-to-pydantic-ai skills are left out.

Official (LangChain), cherry-picked so the plugin's two hosted docs MCPs are not registered. LangGraph via langchain-build-agent; LangSmith via tracing, experiments and monitoring. .legacy skills left out.
Official (Langfuse), synced from claude.ai. Skill fetches Langfuse docs over the network.
Official (Qdrant), synced from claude.ai. Manual only, if ever: mcp-server-qdrant with QDRANT_READ_ONLY=true.

Neo4j devrel (neo4j-contrib org). 5 of 30; neo4j-mcp-skill skipped (flagged for fetching remote code). Manual only, if ever: neo4j-mcp-server with NEO4J_MCP_READ_ONLY=true, NEO4J_MCP_TELEMETRY=false and a read-only DB user.
Official (Docker). Cherry-picked so the plugin's remote docs MCP is not registered.
Official (Redis), the broker/cache subset of redis-development. No MCP: the plugin's docs MCP and mcp-redis are skipped.
Community (Vinta Software, MIT). Covers Django, DRF and Celery. Review the skill text first.
Sentry (Apache-2.0). Two audit skills from a 31-skill repo.
Timescale (Apache-2.0). Skills only; its hosted docs MCP is not installed. Chosen over supabase-postgres-best-practices for the pgvector skill.
Vendor (Confident AI). May point at the Confident AI cloud; inspect first.
Skills ship inside the installed package (FastAPI, Streamlit), so install the repo's dependencies first.
